properties.displayName: UAV S43 - GCS Auto-Update MITM (Rogue Appcast)
properties.description: GCS 앱 자동업데이트 MITM(불법 appcast 응답) 탐지. update_check 이벤트에서 알려진 업데이트 서버 목록(updates.qgroundcontrol.com, update.dah-gcs.mil.kr)에 없는 호스트(SourceHost)로부터 응답을 받았거나, 응답 바이너리가 미서명(BinarySigned=false)인 경우 탐지. MITRE: T1195.002 (closest analogue — Compromise Software Supply Chain, subtechnique of T1195)
properties.query:
let knownUpdateHosts = dynamic(["updates.qgroundcontrol.com", "update.dah-gcs.mil.kr"]);
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVGcsApp_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == "update_check"
| where SourceHost !in (knownUpdateHosts) or BinarySigned == false
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    SourceHost !in (knownUpdateHosts) and BinarySigned == false, "GCS_업데이트_비인가호스트_미서명_동시",
    SourceHost !in (knownUpdateHosts), "GCS_업데이트_비인가_AppcastHost",
    "GCS_업데이트_미서명_바이너리")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, GcsHost, Operator, SourceHost, ResultCode, BinarySigned, PayloadDetail, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S43 - GCS Auto-Update MITM (Rogue Appcast) - {{GcsHost}}
